profile.headline: Software Engineer Civ at HAFB
profile.summary: Proactive engineer with 7+ years of software architecture, integration, and test experience. Experienced in C/C++ embedded software for real-time operating systems (RTOS). Knowledge of Git and DevOps/DevSecOps development process on Linux OS. Proven ability to learn, adapt, and innovate. Strong background in system engineering. Trusted to lead, train, and mentor.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Tracks risks and opportunities to improve earned value management of the ~$96 billion Sentinel ICBM program (ACAT I program).
•	Leads a team of 10 engineers from multiple disciplines including software, mechanical, and system engineering.
•	Product owner
      o	Leads scrum rituals.
      o	Creates team key results and objectives.
      o	Weekly accounting of key results and completed tasks.
      o	Planning and task projection for 3-month increments.
      o	Prioritizing team tasks and work efforts on a bi-weekly basis.
•	Software subject matter expert (SME) over the Launch Guidance Control branch of the USAF Sentinel Program.
•	Represents the program office and senior leadership in critical design reviews.
•	Presents technical briefings to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
•	Coordinates collaboration efforts across multiple branches, contractors, and sub-contractors.
•	Provides technical oversight of software and systems engineering design, development, and integration.
•	Applies process improvement to agile and acquisition strategies including:
      o	Jira (scrum board) story automation scripting
      o	Software maturity evaluation process
      o	Standardized review tracking process to  better capture concerns throughout the acquisition lifecycle and reduce the time of future reviews.
•	Reviews Model-Based Engineering (MBSE) Architectural Model for traceability and adherence to Department of Defense Architectural Framework (DoDAF) standards.
•	Validates that the development process follows contractual requirements regarding testing, configuration management, safety, and coding standards.
•	Tracks progress toward major milestones against an estimated timeline and reports discrepancies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Served as the software architect for two separate products.
•	Mentored team members through paired programming.
•	Developed embedded C++ software for the F-16 Flight Control Computer real-time operating system (RTOS).
•	Devised back-end verification algorithms for updates to pilot weapon system logic.
•	Wrote Google Test unit and system-level self-test for DevOps pipeline.
•	Led scrum team through agile process as product owner. 
•	Authored F-16 datalink requirements and documentation.
•	Reviewed and approved software additions.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Design Test Equipment for missile prime hardware
Create and review electrical sub system drawings
Automate tests for prime hardware in C/C#

positions.title: Intern - pre-silicon verification engineer
positions.description:
Design block level verification test benches in Specman/e
Develop testbenches using UVM techniques
Automate verification tools

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
Help students to acquire the problem solving skills necessary to code in both procedural and object oriented programming in C++ language.
Help the students to understand syntax and structure of the C++ language.

positions.title: Intern - Manufacturing Test Engineer
positions.description:
Work with manufacturing test group to perform failure analysis (FA) on return merchandise authorization (RMA) products. 
Improve and test hardware circuits for testing functionality of product components under various conditions.

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America · May 2009

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteer for the annual "Park Day" to clean up local parks and nature areas across California. Services include picking up trash, removing weeds, planting new trees, etc.

Helped run and officiate the high jump and running events for a Track & Field Meet for the Special Olympic athletes. Cheered and supported athletes throughout the day. This was not a high level competition, but a local event.

organizations.name: Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE)
organizations.description:
Assisted in planning projects for both a semester and yearly timeline
Worked on a "micro-mouse" project
Met with other leadership to start a non-profit electronics store on campus that would provide students with easy access to components they might use to build school projects.
